games.reasoning: The close (-9.5) is the fair number and the slate's -10.5 gives Washington a point; that isn't enough to clear the bar, and the arguments (Cleveland's buy-low spot vs. the Wizards' scoring and Dimers' model) offset. Most interesting angle: Washington's huge split with Davis as the lone big vs. two-big lineups. Forced side Washington on the slate-vs-close point. A confirmed Dybantsa or Davis absence would have changed the read.
